hazel: quick sync 6 bring up q8b-int4 next week. we need a structured promptset curation pass before quant-smoke.
omar: main pain: entity-placeholder churn + markdown list tokenization causing noisy diffs.
hazel: proposed three-pass flow: 1) placeholder normalize (unify @[NAME] -> <PERSON> etc) 2) semantic fuzzy dedupe (sim>0.8) 3) structure-aware dedupe for lists/codeblocks.
kai: for fuzzy, use sim threshold 0.8 and mark 0.65-0.8 as borderline to label.
hazel: dedupe command: ```bash
python3 infra/curate.py \n  --src s3://redwood/promptbank/q8b-raw.jsonl \n  --normalize placeholders \n  --fuzzy 0.8 \n  --borderline 0.65,0.8 \n  --out s3://redwood/promptbank/q8b-curated.jsonl
```
nina: I'll own labeling. prioritize borderline where baseline entropy > 1.4 and token-diff > 6. assign seniors first.
ops-bot: Creating labeling queue `q8b-int4-borderline`. ETA 10m.
labeler-bot: Assigned 9 annotators + 4 reviewers. Rubric: https://labeler.redwood.ai/rubrics/q8b.
oh: hazel: golden bake plan: 1,200 examples, 35% code, 25% longctx (>3k), 150 adversarial edgecases, keep 12% non-en.
kai: add explicit slices: list-summarization, multi-turn roleplay, instruction-clarity.
hazel: eval configs: `quant_smoke_v2.yaml` and `delta_bench_v3.yaml`. include token-diff artifacts and per-token latency.
nina: sending first batch of 400 labeled now. will report QA pass and disagreement stats.
hazel: thanks. will run a small canary on Dedicated (4 GPUs) once golden manifest uploaded. post manifest here when ready.
labeler-bot: Batch 1 (400) complete: reviewer agreement 92%, intent corrections 4.1%. link: https://labeler.redwood.ai/reports/q8b-batch1
hazel: perfect. moving to canary kick. will update with regression deltas and decision to keep int4 shards or fallback to int8.
